data.narrative:
Skild AI is a Series C artificial intelligence and software company founded by Deepak Pathak and Abhinav Gupta, currently valued at $14.0B post-money after raising $1.4B+ to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comparable universe of three same-stage, same-sector private companies (Figure AI at $39.0B, Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, and Together AI at $8.3B), alongside one public comparable (Palantir), plus additional private-stage peers including Scale AI.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $14.0B last post-money, implying a valuation of $23.8B. Peer-median analysis across the three matched comparables yields a median valuation of $10.0B, with a range spanning $8.3B to $39.0B, reflecting material dispersion within the cohort. The wide peer range reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and revenue scale across the sample.

These two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $8.5B (low) to $27.4B (high), with a median of $16.9B. The current $14.0B valuation sits toward the lower end of this range. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and path to profitability relative to peers, capital efficiency of the deployment model, and competitive positioning within AI infrastructure. The peer-median approach suggests meaningful upside potential, though the stage-progression method signals significant variation in outcomes across comparable Series C exits.
